chapters.text: Your numbers come one by one: call, pick what happened, and the next number loads.
Open Calls → Dialer. Numbers come in order: due callbacks, new numbers, then unanswered ones after a few hours.

Working more than one campaign? The campaign name at the top of the Campaign box is a list: pick All my campaigns, or one campaign to call only its numbers (the number in brackets shows how many are waiting). The next number comes from it straight away and AMS remembers your choice.

The Campaign box above the number shows the campaign's name and details, its source, where the numbers came from and who gave them to you. A 2nd round tag means this number wasn't reached the first time.
Choose how you call at the top: Click to call (international numbers through AMS) or Landline (the number is shown big to dial by hand; Start timer measures the call). AMS remembers your choice.
Read the client's details under the name before calling: project and unit they bought, nationality and anything else from the sheet.
Today's target (right side, if your supervisor set one) shows your calls, connected and interested against the target, and how many are still needed.

Press Call (through your extension if the phone system is connected) or WhatsApp. Under the WhatsApp button pick which message to send: the campaign message or one of your templates (Calls → Templates); templates made for this campaign come first with a ★ and are picked for you. The client's name is filled in.
Pick the outcome: Interested, Call back, Not interested / Do not call (never called again), Not answered / Busy, Voicemail, Switched off, Wrong number, Duplicate number or WhatsApp sent.

Interested: remarks are required, so write what they want, budget, area and when to meet. Tick “Send to the CRM”: a CSR agent's lead goes to a sales agent by rotation; a sales agent's lead is assigned to them.
For Call back choose the date and time.

The owner wants to sell or rent out a property? Press Listing (CSR agents): fill in the type, unit / plot number, area, size, demand or rent and the owner's name and phone (already filled in from the call), then Add listing. It goes into Inventory with you as its responsible person.

Press Save & next number: in Click to call mode the next number is called automatically (untick “Call the next number automatically” to stop that). Faster: press 1–9 to pick the result and Ctrl + Enter to save.
Typed a wrong remark? My last calls (right side) shows your 3 latest calls: press Edit, fix the remarks and Save. Older calls can't be changed.

My campaigns (right side) shows how many of your numbers you've called in each campaign. When none is left uncalled, press Mark as completed: numbers you couldn't reach stop coming back (planned callbacks stay) and your supervisor is told.

CSR agents: when you mark a campaign completed, your Not answered, Busy, Voicemail, Switched off and Wrong numbers come back to you as a 2nd round in the same campaign (tagged 2nd round on the dialer), so you can try them once more. There's no 3rd round.

End of the day: write your feedback in the Today so far box and press Save feedback. Today's report fills in by itself (Total Calls, Connected, No Answer, Qualified, Feedback and the totals, in the WhatsApp format); press Send on WhatsApp and pick your team group, or Copy.
